wikioasissafety-desc: Gateway to TSPortal, handles tickets and reports out to T&S, and actions from T&S to mediawiki.
wikioasissafety-link-label: Get help or report a problem
wikioasissafety-special-title: Get help or report a problem
wikioasissafety-special-nojs: This form needs JavaScript. If you cannot enable it, email your report to safety@wikioasis.org instead.
wikioasissafety-title: Get help or report a problem
wikioasissafety-noflow: This report form is not set up correctly. Please email safety@wikioasis.org instead.
wikioasissafety-error-checkbox-required: This must be checked to continue.
wikioasissafety-error-summary: Please fix the highlighted fields before continuing.
wikioasissafety-submitted: Thank you for reporting. Your report has been submitted.
wikioasissafety-submitted-details: We will reach out to you if we need more information. You can follow the report on your Trust & Safety page, Special:SafetyHome.
wikioasissafety-submitted-details-anonym: Nothing identifying you was sent with it, so we cannot come back to you for more information or tell you what happened to it.
wikioasissafety-file-willupload: These are sent to Trust & Safety alongside your message. Please ensure they do not contain sensitive information.
wikioasissafety-file-uploaded: {{PLURAL:$1|$1 file was|$1 files were}} sent with your report.
wikioasissafety-file-notsent: {{PLURAL:$1|One file could not be sent|$1 files could not be sent}}: $2. Your report itself has been filed. You can reply to it on your Trust & Safety page to send them again, or email them quoting the reference.
wikioasissafety-file-lost: the file itself was no longer available to send
wikioasissafety-file-uploadfailed: it could not be sent just now
wikioasissafety-file-toobig-portal: it is larger than Trust & Safety accepts ($1)
wikioasissafety-file-toobig-wiki: this wiki will not accept a file that large ($1)
wikioasissafety-file-toomany: $1 was not added: the limit is {{PLURAL:$2|$2 file|$2 files}}.
wikioasissafety-file-badtype: $1 is not an accepted file type.
wikioasissafety-home-disabled: Trust & Safety tools are disabled on this wiki. Please email safety@wikioasis.org for inquiries.
wikioasissafety-home-nojs: This page needs JavaScript. To report a problem without it, go to [[$1]], or email safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-home-intro: Report something, check your account status, or follow up on something you have already sent.
wikioasissafety-home-temporary: Temporary accounts cannot use this. Log in or create an account.
wikioasissafety-home-report-description: Tell us about harassment, copyright violations, threats of harm, or anything else that needs attention.
wikioasissafety-home-data-description: Ask us to delete the personal data we hold about you.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-description: See how the reports and tickets you have filed are going, and add anything new.
wikioasissafety-home-account-description: Check whether any action has been taken against your account.
wikioasissafety-home-contact-description: Ask a question, appeal a sanction, or raise something that fits nowhere else.
wikioasissafety-home-appeal-none: You have no sanctions that can be appealed.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-intro: Open a report to read our response, or to add some more information.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-empty: You have not filed any reports.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-anonymous: Reports filed anonymously are not listed here.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-nocomments: Nothing has been added to this report yet.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-add-descrip: Has something else happened, or is there something you left out? Add it here.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-add-placeho: What has happened since you filed this?
wikioasissafety-home-account-noactions: Thank you for upholding WikiOasis' terms of use. There are no active actions on your account.
wikioasissafety-home-account-good: Your account is in good standing
wikioasissafety-home-account-good-detail: There are no active actions on your account
wikioasissafety-home-account-restricted-: You can still edit, actions in force are shown below.
wikioasissafety-home-account-suspended-d: You cannot edit while this is in force. Why it happened and when it ends are listed below.
wikioasissafety-home-account-appeal: If you think one of these was wrong, you can ask Trust & Safety to review the action.
wikioasissafety-home-account-appeal-none: You can contact Trust & Safety about anything above.
wikioasissafety-nojs-nofiles: Attaching files needs JavaScript. If you wish to attach files, email safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-nojs-noreport: That report could not be found.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent: Trust & Safety has received your case. The reference is $1.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-follow: You can follow it on [[Special:SafetyHome|your Trust & Safety page]].
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-anonymous: This was filed anonymously, there will be no updates on it and we cannot follow up about it. Keep the reference: it is the only way to refer to this case.
wikioasissafety-submit-sent-temp: This case is attached to your temporary account, there will be no updates on it. Keep the reference: it is the only way to refer to this case.
wikioasissafety-submit-queued: This case has been recorded, but we couldn't reach Trust and Safety just now. It is saved and will be sent at a later time. You do not need to submit it again.
wikioasissafety-submit-throttled: This has not been sent: you are being ratelimited. Wait an hour and try again. If it cannot wait, email safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-submit-failed: This could not be sent to Trust & Safety. Please try again, or email safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-comment-queued: Added. We couldn't reach Trust and Safety just now. It is saved and will be sent at a later time. You do not need to submit it again.
wikioasissafety-comment-failed: This could not be sent. Your text has been kept in the box — please try again.
wikioasissafety-portal-unconfigured: This wiki has not been connected to Trust & Safety yet, so nothing can be submitted from here. Please email [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org].
wikioasissafety-portal-unreachable: Trust and Safety could not be reached.
wikioasissafety-portal-refused: Trust and Safety could not accept this. Please retry, or email [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org].
wikioasissafety-portal-badpayload: This submission could not be prepared for sending.
wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable: '''Your account has been disabled by Trust & Safety.''' The reference is '''$1'''. The duration is indefinite. You can request a review of this action, by [$2 making an appeal] $4 You can also write to [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org], quoting $1.
wikioasissafety-suspended-appealable-exp: '''Your account has been disabled by Trust & Safety.''' The reference is '''$1'''. This ends on {{formatdate:$3}}, after which you will be able to log in as normal. You can request a review of this action, by [$2 making an appeal]. $4 You can also write to [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org], quoting $1.
wikioasissafety-suspended-final: '''Your account has been disabled by Trust & Safety.''' The reference is '''$1'''. The duration is indefinite. $4 For inquiries, you can write to [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org], quoting $1.
wikioasissafety-suspended-final-expiring: '''Your account has been disabled by Trust & Safety.''' The reference is '''$1'''. This ends on {{formatdate:$3}}, after which you will be able to log in as normal. $4 For inquiries, you can write to [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org], quoting $1.
centralauth-login-error-locked:
This account has been locked and cannot be used to log in.

If Trust & Safety locked it, you can [[Special:SafetyAppeal|ask them to look at it again]] — you do not need to be able to log in, and a person reads every appeal. You can also write to safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-suspended-reason: The reason recorded for this action was $1
wikioasissafety-suspended-reason-withhel: The reason could not be shown here. Please email [mailto:safety@wikioasis.org safety@wikioasis.org] for more information.
wikioasissafety-appeal-intro:
If Trust & Safety has disabled your account and you think that was wrong, you can ask for a review of the action again here. You do not need to be able to log in.

They may take some time, and they will write to the address you give below when they have an outcome for you.
wikioasissafety-appeal-username-help: The account that was disabled, as it appears onwiki.
wikioasissafety-appeal-email: An address we can reply to
wikioasissafety-appeal-email-help: Please provide an email to allow us to reach out for further information and to let you know of the outcome.
wikioasissafety-appeal-text: What you would like Trust & Safety to (re)consider
wikioasissafety-appeal-text-help: Anything you think they got wrong, or anything that has changed since. Take as much space as you need.
wikioasissafety-appeal-sent: Your appeal has been sent. The reference is '''$1'''. Trust & Safety will write to the address you gave.
wikioasissafety-appeal-duplicate: An appeal against this is already open with Trust & Safety, under the reference '''$1'''. There is nothing more you need to do; sending another would not make it any quicker.
wikioasissafety-appeal-queued: Your appeal has been taken, but the Trust & Safety system could not be reached just now. It is saved on this wiki and will be sent automatically. You do not need to send it again.
notification-header-wikioasissafety-acti: An action has been taken on your account: $1 ($2).
An action on your account has been lifted: $1 ($2).
notification-body-wikioasissafety: Open your Trust & Safety home to see more.
echo-pref-tooltip-wikioasissafety: Tell me when Trust & Safety replies to a case I opened, or takes an action on my account.
apierror-wikioasissafety-badpayload: The submission could not be read.
apierror-wikioasissafety-nofile: No file arrived with that upload.
apierror-wikioasissafety-badsignature: This request was not signed with a secret that is recognised, or it is too old.
apierror-wikioasissafety-unsignedparam: This request carried $1 in its URL, which the signature does not cover. Send every parameter in the signed request body.
apierror-wikioasissafety-replayed: This request has already been processed.
apierror-wikioasissafety-nosecret: This wiki has no Trust & Safety shared secret configured.
apierror-wikioasissafety-syncfailed: The update could not be stored: $1
apierror-wikioasissafety-nocase: There is no such case for this account.
apierror-wikioasissafety-appealincomplet: An appeal needs an account name and something to consider.
apierror-wikioasissafety-unsupportedtask: This action can't be carried out yet.
apierror-wikioasissafety-tasknotready: Not ready to do that yet: $1
wikioasissafety-checkuser-nolog: There is no CheckUser log to send.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-unde: Not decided yet. We will write to you when it has been reviewed.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-unma: We don't know which action this appeal is about. If you know its reference, add it below and we will pick it up.
wikioasissafety-home-reports-appeal-outc: Partly granted — the action was reduced or modified
wikioasissafety-flow-triage-title: What would you like to do?
wikioasissafety-flow-triage-description: Get guidance on inappropriate user behaviour, or report an incident to Trust & Safety.
wikioasissafety-flow-help-unacceptable-d: Sockpuppetry, spam, vandalism, personal attacks or similar.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-threat-descr: Intent to commit violence against an individual, themself (self-harm), or an act of mass violence.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-licensing-de: Copyright violations, unlicensed pages or media.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-child-descri: Child pornography, grooming, or another risk to the safety of a minor on the platform.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-harassment-d: Somebody persistently harassing you or someone else.
wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage: A user is too young to use WikiOasis
wikioasissafety-flow-report-underage-des: Somebody who has said that they are too young to use WikiOasis (under 13).
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-pages-desc: One or more pages on a wiki are problematic
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-users-desc: One or more users are problematic
wikioasissafety-flow-concerns-wikis-desc: One or more wikis are problematic
wikioasissafety-flow-pages-label: Which pages does this report concern?
wikioasissafety-flow-pages-description: You can report one, or multiple, pages. Start typing to search.
wikioasissafety-flow-users-label: Which users does this report concern?
wikioasissafety-flow-users-description: You can report one, or multiple, users. Start typing to search accounts, or type an IP address.
wikioasissafety-flow-wikis-label: Which wikis does this report concern?
wikioasissafety-flow-wikis-description: You can report one, or multiple wikis. Start typing to search, or type a full wiki domain name.
wikioasissafety-flow-details-description: Explain what went on, including evidence, such as diffs and links.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-de: This helps us prioritise cases which need to be looked at sooner.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-no: Somebody is in danger right now
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-immediacy-th: It has been threatened, but not carried out
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-authorities-: Are local authorities aware of this?
If somebody is in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency services in addition to reporting.
wikioasissafety-flow-threat-where-descri: A page, a diff, or a link. If it was not made on a wiki, tell us where rather than linking to it.
wikioasissafety-flow-licensing-standing-: What is your connection to the material?
I hold the rights to it
I am acting for the rights holder
wikioasissafety-flow-licensing-source-de: A link, an ISBN, or wherever the original can be seen.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-notice: If a child is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services, then report to us. We work in collaboration with law enforcement, but cannot always immediately respond to reports.
wikioasissafety-flow-child-nature-contac: Grooming, or unwanted contact with a minor
wikioasissafety-flow-child-nature-person: A minor's personal information has been published
wikioasissafety-flow-child-nature-other: Something else that puts a minor at risk
wikioasissafety-flow-child-authorities-l: Are local authorities aware of this?
wikioasissafety-flow-child-authorities-d: If somebody is in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency services in addition to reporting.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-kind-title: What would you like to do?
wikioasissafety-flow-data-kind-descripti: Ask us to delete the personal data we hold about you. To request access to your data, please use the contact us form.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-request-erase-: We will remove the personal data we hold about your account. Your edits themselves will stay.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-in: Tell us what you would like removed. Deleting an account entirely is not possible, your edits will stay, but be assigned to a random username.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-me: All WikiOasis data associated with my account
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-scope-co: I understand that deleted data cannot be recovered.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-notice: Please do not send us the person's real name, school, address, or anything else that would identify. A statement of age is all that we need to take action.
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-onwi: They said their age on a wiki
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-basis-else: They said their age somewhere else
wikioasissafety-flow-underage-where-desc: A page, a diff, or a link. If it was said somewhere out of WikiOasis jurisdiction, describe where rather than linking to it.
wikioasissafety-flow-threattolife-label: I believe there is a current threat to life against someone involved in this report. I have made sure to identify who this person is.
wikioasissafety-flow-anonymous-descripti: If you choose to submit anonymously, you will not receive status updates on your report, and we will not be able to reach out to find further information.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-sockpuppet: Abuse of multiple accounts can be reported to the counter-vandalism team at cvu@wikioasis.org, or by clicking this card to visit the counter-vandalism noticeboard.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-spam-descr: Spam can be reported to a local administrator, or by clicking this card to visit the counter-vandalism noticeboard.
wikioasissafety-flow-guidance-vandalism-: Vandalism can be reported to a local administrator, or by clicking this card to visit the counter-vandalism noticeboard.
wikioasissafety-category-threat-of-physi: Violence against another person, self-harm, or mass violence.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-copy-elsewhere: Asking for a copy of the personal data we hold about you is not yet available here. Please write to safety@wikioasis.org.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-descript: We will remove the personal data we hold about your account: the email address on it, your real name where it is recorded, IP addresses logged against your edits, and your user pages. Your edits themselves stay, attributed to a randomised username.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-details-: Anything you would like us to know?
Optional. If some of this is urgent, or there is a reason we should treat it as such, this is the place to say so.
wikioasissafety-flow-data-erase-confirm-: I understand that this cannot be undone, and that my account will be renamed rather than deleted.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-gene: Anything you would like to ask us.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-appe: Ask us to look again at an action taken against your account.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-reason-othe: If none of the above fits.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-message-lab: What would you like to say?
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-desc: Tell us which action you would like us to look at again, and why.
wikioasissafety-flow-contact-appeal-grou: What we got wrong, or what has changed since.
